hero.h1: Meditation with a Monk in a Park
hero.tagline: Press pause on the week. Sit down in the grass, breathe, and feel something real — together.

about.h2: Three gentle parts, sixty unhurried minutes
about.lead: We gather as the evening softens. No experience needed — just come as you are.

steps.title: Music & mantra
steps.desc: We open with live music and simple chant to settle the mind.

steps.title: Silent meditation
steps.desc: Guided into stillness, then quiet together beneath the trees.

steps.title: Tea & fika
steps.desc: We close with warm tea, something sweet, and easy conversation.

bringItems: Something to sit on — we bring extra mats
A warm layer for when the sun dips
about.donationNote: The gathering is free and donation-based. Give what feels right — or nothing at all.

teacher.name: Dada Anandasvarupa
teacher.bio1: Dada Anandasvarupa is a yogic monk who has lived the monk's life for over 7 years. For the past 4+ years he has lived and trained here in Sweden.
teacher.bio2: He guides these evenings with warmth and a light touch — you'll feel welcome from the first minute.

location.lead: We meet at the same spot in the park every week. Exact location below — see you there.

items.a: Something to sit on — a mat, blanket or cushion. That's it. Come in any clothes and any mood.
Yes. It's donation based — give if you want to, but nothing is expected.
About one hour: 20 min music & mantra, 20 min silent meditation, 20 min tea & fika.
